content: .{@-एकः@} {%a.%} .²1 ‘not one’, more than one, several, various; नैकः सुप्तेषु जागृयात् <ls>Viduranīti.</ls> .²2 Not anyone, nobody; नैको मुनिर्यस्य वचः प्रमाणम् <ls>Pt.</ls> . ({@-कः@}) an epithet of Viṣṇu.

नैक {%a.%} [न-एक] .²1 Not one or alone (mostly in <ab>comp.</ab>); नैको मुनिर्यस्य वचः प्रमाणम्. .²2 Various, manifold; नैकरागस्फुरितमणिरुचः <ls>Mu. 3. 19</ls>. See under न. ˚आत्मन् {%m.%}, ˚रूपः, ˚शृगः epithets of the Supreme Being. .{@-कः@} An epithet of Viṣṇu.
